title: feat(audit): record the administrator on writes made while impersonating a user
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D2wBtp9QdSCM6fjWYgVvAPi)_

Fixes #30213

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:管理员模拟员工时做的每一次写入,审计日志(`sys_audit_log.metadata.impersonated_by`)和记录动态(`sys_activity`)都记下这位管理员;记录详情页的动态与字段历史显示「Dev Admin 代王工操作」。数据归属、`created_by`、权限仍是员工本人,没有加列、没有迁移。
- 为什么改:裁决 A(「A」)。之前模拟会话里的写入与员工本人的写入在审计上完全一样,事后查不出是谁做的。
- 风险与回滚:新字段只用于记录,授权路径不读它;回滚即还原本 PR,老数据不受影响(老行本来就没有这个键)。评论是分岔:评论不写任何审计/动态行,本 PR 没有改,交您定夺(见下方 Acceptance notes)。
- 先看:`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`(从会话读出管理员)、`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`(写入审计与动态的那几行)、`packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts`(审批人接手后不再沿用管理员)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/activity-actor-name.test.ts`,预期 15 个用例全绿,其中 5 个是本卡的(审计行带 `impersonated_by`、动态行带管理员名、员工本人写入不带、钩子里的调用者仍是员工)。
- 需要你做的:评论那一处的分岔选一个方向(见 Acceptance notes 的 needs_decision 三个选项);其余无,席位落地(本 PR 触 `packages/spec`,落地前欠一次契约级复核)。

## What changes

An administrator who impersonates a user writes as that user. Before this PR nothing on the write said otherwise: the `sys_audit_log` row (`user_id` and `actor` both the user, `metadata` empty), the `sys_activity` row and the record were byte-identical to the user's own work. Only the sign-in row named the administrator.

This PR carries the administrator as an attribution-only fact, in the additive shape an agent's write already uses (`performed_by` / `on_behalf_of`):

- **Spec.** `ExecutionContext.impersonatedBy` (optional string, a `sys_user` id) and `HookContext.provenance.impersonatedBy`, both documented as attribution only. `AutomationContext.impersonatedBy` lets a flow started by such a write carry it.
- **Request identity.** `resolveAuthzContext`'s session arm reads `session.impersonatedBy` off the same session read that admitted the caller (session credential only; an API key carries none). `assembleExecutionContext` emits it on both entries (never on a guest envelope). Every transport that uses the shared resolver (REST, the runtime dispatcher, MCP) gets it from that one place.
- **Engine.** `buildProvenance` copies it into the hook context's `provenance`, never into `session`. The sandbox body runner projects it like the other provenance members.
- **Audit writers.** The CRUD mirror stamps `sys_audit_log.metadata.impersonated_by` and adds `impersonated_by` plus `impersonated_by_name` (the administrator's name, from the same memoized `sys_user` read as `actor_name`) to the `sys_activity` row's metadata. The `action_invocation` row stamps `impersonated_by` too. Each key appears only on such a write, so its absence means the user acted themselves. `user_id`, `actor` and `actor_id` do not move (ADR-0118 D1/D5).
- **Flows started by the write.** The record-change trigger reads `provenance.impersonatedBy` into the run's `AutomationContext`; `resolveRunDataContext` puts it on every data node's context on both `runAs` arms; it survives suspension with the persisted context. When an approval decision hands the run to a decider, the decider's segment drops it (they act in their own name).
- **Console.** The record timeline (`record:activity`, the console record page's merged feed), `record:history` and the record page's field history (from `sys_audit_log`) read 「Dev Admin 代王工操作」: new key `detail.impersonatedActor` in all ten console languages. An administrator whose name the writer could not read shows as the unknown-user text, never as "System" or a raw id.

What the audit reader shows now, for a ticket created by Dev Admin impersonating 王工: `sys_audit_log` row `user_id = 王工`, `actor = 王工`, `metadata = {"impersonated_by": "<Dev Admin's id>"}`; `sys_activity` row `actor_id = 王工`, `actor_name = 王工`, metadata carrying `impersonated_by` and `impersonated_by_name: "Dev Admin"`; the record's `created_by` stays 王工; the timeline line reads 「Dev Admin 代王工操作」.

### The ruling's verify list (comment 6647756733), item by item

- **Every write door stamps it.**
  - Generic data route: yes, through the shared resolver every transport uses.
  - Actions: yes. The action body's context spreads the caller's envelope (`buildActionExecutionContext`), so its writes carry it; the `action_invocation` row carries it.
  - Flows started by the write: yes, on both `runAs` arms, until a decider takes over.
  - **Comments: no. This is a fork, reported, not narrowed** (see Acceptance notes).
- **The fact does not reach a caller-gating hook as the caller.** Yes, pinned: a `beforeInsert` hook in an impersonated write sees `session.userId` = the user, nothing naming the administrator in `session`, and `provenance = { impersonatedBy }`.
- **Console display is new work.** Built for the activity rows and the audit-log field history. The shared rendering does not also show agent writes (`performed_by`); left out to keep this PR to the ruling.
- **Sub-point: everyone who can read the record sees the administrator on the timeline.** Yes. `sys_activity` metadata is served to every reader of the row; `sys_audit_log.metadata` is not narrowed (`audit-log-field-redaction.ts`'s note updated to say so).
- **Sub-point: fill the empty `ip_address` if cheap.** Not done. The hook context carries no request IP, so filling it means a second envelope field set at every door. That is not cheap, and the ruling says it must not hold the rest.

## Tests

- `plugin-audit` `activity-actor-name.test.ts`: five new cases. An impersonated insert stamps `sys_audit_log.metadata.impersonated_by` with `user_id`/`actor` still the user. The `sys_activity` row carries `impersonated_by` and `impersonated_by_name`. The user's own write carries neither key (control). A `beforeInsert` hook sees the user in `session` and the administrator only in `provenance`. `action-invocation-audit.test.ts`: the invocation row stamps it.
- `core`: `resolve-authz-context.test.ts` (an impersonation session yields it with the user's grants; the user's own session does not) and `assemble-execution-context.test.ts` (both entries carry it, a guest envelope never does).
- `trigger-record-change`: the run's `AutomationContext` carries the write's `provenance.impersonatedBy`.
- `service-automation` `resume-decider-identity.integration.test.ts`: data nodes carry it on both `runAs` arms, and the decider's segment after an approval drops it (plus a control).
- `cli` `lowered-body-face-enumeration.test.ts`: the provenance member set now includes `impersonatedBy`.
- Console: `recordActivityFeed.actorId-12067.test.tsx` (composed actor line, unknown administrator falls back to the unknown-user text, never "System") and `auditHistoryDisplay.test.ts` (`auditImpersonatorId`).
- Ablation: deleting the audit stamp line in `audit-writers.ts` turns the ledger pin red (1 failed / 14 passed); restored, blob equal to HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- **needs_decision: comments.** `sys_comment` is in plugin-audit's `SKIP_OBJECTS`, so a comment writes no `sys_audit_log` and no `sys_activity` row at all, impersonated or not, and its `author_id` is the impersonated user. The ruling's verify list names comments as a write door, so this is reported, not narrowed. Options:
  - **(a)** Stop skipping `sys_comment` in the audit mirror, so a comment gets the same ledger and activity rows (and the stamp) as any write. Widest change: every comment starts writing two rows.
  - **(b)** Stamp the fact on the comment row itself. `sys_comment` has no metadata or JSON field today, so this needs a new column and a migration, which ruling A excludes; it would need its own ruling.
  - **(c)** Leave comments as they are and record it as a known gap in the ruling's follow-up.
  ⛔ No column and no ledger row was added for comments in this PR.
- Agent writes (`performed_by`) are not shown by the new console line; out of the ruling's scope.
- `ip_address` is not filled (see the verify list).
- Not re-measured against a live deployment; the evidence is the unit and integration pins above.
- Touches `packages/spec` (widening, optional members only): a contract-review-tier review is owed before the queue.

## Verification

- Full `turbo build` 119/119 on the merge head; `typecheck` exit 0 for spec, core, objectql, runtime, plugin-audit, trigger-record-change, service-automation, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- Package suites: plugin-audit 30, core 341, trigger-record-change 52, service-automation 26, console 3091 + record-detail view 651 (102/102 files), all green.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 116 derived families, 116 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its base commit fetched in the shallow clone; exit 0 after that (48 cases).
- `spec` `gen:docs` regenerated `content/docs/references/{data/data-engine,data/hook,kernel/execution-context}.mdx`.

Changed lines: 45 files, 654 insertions, 28 deletions (682, under 3000).
